rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
rules.description: Extracting files from a malicious ZIP file, or similar type of archive, without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can allow an attacker to unexpectedly gain access to resources.

rules.cwe_name: Relative Path Traversal
rules.description: Accessing paths influenced by users can allow an attacker to access unexpected resources.

rules.cwe_name: Access of Resource Using Incompatible Type ('Type Confusion')
rules.description: Sanitizing an HTTP request parameter may be ineffective if the user controls its type.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Comparison
rules.description: A security-relevant comparison checks the wrong, incomplete, or non-canonical value.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Handling of Case Sensitivity
rules.description: Middleware with case-sensitive paths do not protect endpoints with case-insensitive paths.

rules.cwe_name: Expression is Always True
rules.description: Comparing the result of a typeof test against a string other than 'undefined', 'boolean', 'number', 'string', 'object', 'function' or 'symbol' is useless, since this comparison can never succeed.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: If the 'X-Frame-Options' setting is not provided, a malicious user may be able to overlay their own UI on top of the site by using an iframe.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
rules.description: Directly sending file data in an outbound network request can indicate unauthorized information disclosure.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Data within XPath Expressions ('XPath Injection')
rules.description: Building an XPath expression from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious code by the user.

rules.cwe_name: Protection Mechanism Failure
rules.description: The Helmet middleware is used to set security-related HTTP headers in Express applications. This query finds instances where the middleware is configured with important security features disabled.

rules.cwe_name: Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition
